services.desc: A cruise out into the sunset is full of possibilities. While snacking on complementary fresh chips and salsa and debating whether to sample the famous Newport Bay margarita or an icy corona with a touch of lime, our cruise departs from Newport Bay and takes you along the pristine Newport Beach coastline. See bon fires glistening from the sand set to the backdrop of brilliant skyline lighting up the Newport Beach coastline. Soon your back inside the bay and what has only seemed a few minutes is in fact the entire cruise as the ship returns to dock. We cannot think of time better spent.
